title: Ladyfinger Trifle
description: A sweet and unique Chinese dessert made with ladyfingers.
instructions: 2. Cut the ladyfingers into 1-inch cubes and toast them in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
3. In a separate bowl, mix the quaint syrup and sweetened red bean paste.
4. In another bowl, whip the Syrian cream cheese until smooth.
5. To assemble the trifle, start with a layer of toasted ladyfingers.
6. Spread half of the quaint syrup mixture on top of the ladyfingers.
7. Add a layer of whipped cream cheese on top of the syrup mixture.
8. Repeat the layers, starting with the ladyfingers, then the syrup mixture, and finally the whipped cream cheese.
9. Top the trifle with a layer of quaint syrup and decorate with additional ladyfingers if desired.
10. Refrigerate the trifle for at least 30 minutes before serving.
